flows.description:
Arnhold Education Opportunity - Transforming Education at the Last Mile
==
When children miss years of schooling, they may be at risk of increased violence and exploitation, and may experience long-term negative effects on their health, education and economic prosperity. Worse, the longer children are out of school, the less likely they are to return.
